children: Suley brings over 28 years of HR experience across automotive, manufacturing, plant HR and employee relations
Varroc has appointed Jatin Suley as Cluster Head HR, strengthening its HR leadership in the automotive components business.

Suley brings more than 28 years of experience across human resources, employee relations, plant HR, HR operations and workforce management, with a career spanning automotive, engineering, manufacturing and industrial organisations.

Before joining Varroc, Suley was Senior Manager, Human Resources Operations at TM Automotive Seating Systems in Maharashtra. He previously served as Senior Manager Human Resources and Plant HR Head at Lucas TVS, gaining experience in managing people operations within manufacturing environments.

A significant part of his career was spent at Bosch India, where he worked for more than 12 years across HR and employee relations roles, including HR Manager and Employee Relations Manager. He later joined KEC International as Chief Manager Human Resources in Jaipur.
Earlier in his career, Suley held HR roles at Pernod Ricard, Seagram Distilleries, Perfect Circle India and Nitiraj Engineers, following his early career stint at Ashoka Buildcon.

At Varroc, Suley will bring his experience in plant HR, employee and labour relations and workforce management to the automotive components manufacturer. The appointment comes as Varroc continues to build its workforce capabilities across its manufacturing operations.

Varroc is a global Tier-1 automotive component supplier with operations spanning exterior lighting, polymer and plastic components, electrical and electronic components and precision metallic components. The company operates manufacturing facilities and R&D centres across multiple countries.
